prioritized_defects.description: The combined maintenance/load node N47-N48 groups multiple support concerns into a single flow that is not clearly supported as one executable use case, and it may misrepresent the intended separate maintenance requirements.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R12-R20 describe maintainer qualifications and separate operational concerns: Java/socket familiarity, crash diagnosis and repair, program modification, frequent operations, heavy transfer, and overload strategies. The diagram compresses them into a single action chain N46 -> N47 -> N48, which implies one linear activity rather than distinct support requirements.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Model these support requirements separately or annotate the diagram to clarify that the node is only a summary and not a single required execution path.

final_recommendation: Prioritize the HIGH-severity requirement coverage defects first, then address the MEDIUM-severity control-flow dead ends, and finish with the hallucination concern.
